text:
Nina (CSM): FYI Perseus asked for a short preflight: EU routing to eu-west1, temporary QPS bump for a 3h launch, and a header exemption for our bot-rate limiter. They're clear this launch is critical to converting their trial into a paid contract.
Maya (CS): Launch window they gave: 2024-07-08 08:00-11:00 UTC. Expected spikes ~180-220 rps peak (mostly chat short responses). They want a 3x QPS lift on /v1/chat and a smaller bump on embeddings for telemetry.
Omar (Sales): If we greenlight, can Sales get a 1-page addendum: start/end times, surge rates, and contact for emergency rollback? They said procurement can sign the addendum immediately.
Leah (Billing): We need estimated token delta and a temporary surge rate to apply so finance isn't surprised. Can we tag usage for this customer so it shows up separately?
Sam (Eng-Infra): We can add a per-route override and tag usage with customer_id=perseus. Need confirmation of which exact routes and whether they will include the special header `X-Perseus-Mode: live`.
Tess (NetOps): For routing I'll need their IP ranges or ask them to NAT through known prefixes. Do they want edge-peering or just geo-routing to eu-west?
Nina (CSM): They provided these CIDRs: 44.55.66.0/24 and 18.32.0.0/16. They prefer our hosted plan with regional failover (no Dedicated). Header will be `X-Perseus-Mode: live`.
ops-bot: Created NET-5209 for egress/ACL and EDGE-9930 for regional route.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Proposed config draft: ```json
{
  "customer":"perseus",
  "routes":["/v1/chat","/v1/embeddings"],
  "header_match":"X-Perseus-Mode: live",
  "qps_override_chat":150,
  "qps_override_embeddings":40,
  "start":"2024-07-08T08:00:00Z",
  "end":"2024-07-08T11:05:00Z",
  "revert_grace":300,
  "alert_threshold_pct":80
}
```
Maya (CS): Add tests: schedule a preflight curl 20 minutes before start from one of their IPs and a canary load at 50% expected peak. Also confirm the header bypass doesn't accidentally allow automation abuse.
Tess (NetOps): I'll attach rollback contact perseus-net@perseus.co and our oncall @tess. We'll monitor egress peering and health during the window. NET-5209 updated with CIDRs and times.
Leah (Billing): Tagging requests: please include `billing_tag: perseus_launch_jul8` in the rate policy. I'll create a temporary invoice line item in the accounting system for surge.
Omar (Sales): Perseus legal said: "we'll sign addendum if Redwood confirms routing + test." I'm pushing for PO today.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Tech note: we'll bypass bot-check throttles for this header only for matched routes and origin CIDRs. We'll also enable a canary route in staging first. ETA to push to staging after NetOps green: 3 hours.
Nina (CSM): Action items summary: 1) NetOps finalize ACL & route (Tess) 2) Eng push rate policy + header rule to staging and prod (Sam) 3) Billing surge tag and addendum (Leah/Omar) 4) Perseus send PO and run preflight test 20m before.
Maya (CS): Risk callout: if egde capacity in eu-west is overcommitted, we may need to route some traffic to eu-central as fallback. Sam can set an automatic fallback policy.
Sam (Eng-Infra): I'll add fallback to eu-central with degraded QPS and a 429 fallback metric so Sales knows potential user impact.
Tess (NetOps): Green across the board. NET-5209 shows egress ACLs configured; monitoring setup.
Leah (Billing): I'll prep the surge billing addendum draft and email it to Nina and Omar for signatures.
Nina (CSM): Perseus confirmed via DM: "Header approach ok, testing scheduled for 07-08 07:40 UTC." They also said renewal decision tied to launch success.
Omar (Sales): Pushed PO; they replied "PO_7893 attached, signature pending after test."
Maya (CS): Great. Please post the 20m preflight test results in this thread.
ops-bot: EDGE-9930 -> in-progress. NET-5209 -> in-progress. Assigned to Tess and Sam.
